info.title: Script Master Labs — x402 Data API
info.description: Pay-per-call crypto, RWA, federal, SEC, Section 8/HUD housing, and compliance APIs. Settled in USDC on Base via x402. Hyphen routes only (e.g. /x402/gas-tracker, /x402/pha-lookup, /x402/sec-8k).

rails.note: EIP-3009 via X-PAYMENT — settled through a hybrid facilitator chain.
Pay USDC then send X-PAYMENT-TX — verified directly on-chain, no facilitator.
